headline: Banyan supports added; Kula burn scar fencing and replanting update

meeting.summary: The Arborist Committee heard a banyan tree update, planned exceptional tree measurements, and heard about fencing and replanting in the Kula burn scar.
meeting.recap: The committee confirmed it had quorum by roll call.[[0:00:41]] A member moved to approve the last meeting's minutes, and another member seconded.[[0:02:03]] The chair said eight of 16 supports were added to the banyan tree's side branches about two weeks ago.[[0:02:31]] The chair said the banyan tree will stay closed for another year and a half.[[0:03:56]] Members were asked to pick trees from the exceptional tree list to measure.[[0:04:16]] The chair said members have already approved the monkeypod trees at the University of Hawaiʻi.[[0:06:48]] The chair said trees that died or burned in the fire will be removed from the list through an ordinance update.[[0:08:11]] The chair is doing tree value assessments so families can get more money back from the lawsuit.[[0:08:43]] The chair described a fruit forest with the county parks department to provide more fruit for the community.[[0:10:33]] A member with the Kula Community Watershed Alliance said the group is putting deer fencing around the Kula burn scar.[[0:11:10]] Over a thousand plants have been planted in the fully fenced upper section.[[0:11:33]] Over 200 deer were removed from the area in the last year.[[0:12:12]] The next meeting is October 14th.[[0:14:29]] A motion to adjourn was made and seconded.[[0:15:42]]
decided: A motion to approve the minutes was made and seconded, but no vote was heard in the recording.
A motion to adjourn was made and seconded, but no vote was heard in the recording.
meeting.next: Members are asked to confirm once they have their logins and then start measuring their trees. An arborist will return with a spider lift to do more trimming on the banyan tree once it is scheduled. The chair will contact the watershed group next week about a volunteer app that is in development.

moments.q: "there's more native plants growing in this gulch than there were before the fire"
